_doc: Presentation figures of the world view (game/ only, no rule reads them). GDD 4.15 gives the day/night colours; the rest is provisional greybox (H1) until the art arrives. zoom_levels: only values that keep pixels whole (D2). tint_strength: how far the phase colour pulls from white (1 = the raw colour, too dark for #1A1A40 at night). transition_minutes: game minutes a phase takes to blend in from the previous one.

buildings._doc: H2 greybox of the buildings of state.buildings on the map (by type): block colour and height, sign and door colours.

interior._doc: H2 greybox interior (GDD 4.6.4): zoom, fade (in+out, seconds), kit colours and heights, station blocks, the master-touch blink.
